reason: Document B wins my trust as a cautious backer by actually doing the math on the minimum funding goal (showing that 572 backers covers the full 1,500-copy print run plus shipping) and committing to a specific monthly update schedule. Document A includes unverified claims like 'hundreds of tables' and 'four winters,' whereas B's humility about the small sample size of BGG ratings feels much more honest for a first-time creator.
